pages.text: A driving car: about 100 km/h, with seats for eight behind the cab.

The Bullet Train is a set: a $(l)driving car$() at each end, noses out, with $(item)Bullet Train Coaches$() between them (as many as the train length allows). Drive it from either end: climb into the cab at the end you want to lead. On a timetable it shuttles back and forth without turning.

Both driving cars pull and run on batteries (1,500,000 MJ each), charged at a $(l:depots/charging_point)charging point$(/l); under $(l:electric/overhead_lines)overhead wires$(/l) both raise their pantographs and run from the wire.$(br2)Signals, stations and speed signs look further ahead for it, so it slows in time at full speed.
The Bullet Train standing at the station.
